verdict.reason: Supertubos is worth a quick check for after work (17:30 start), but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should be manageable, but not a big advantage.  The tide is lining up for a powerful wedge, so keep the comfort level in mind.

conversationalSummary.text: TODAY, I’d check the cams first before heading out—Supertubos looks like the best bet after work (around a 17:30 start), but it’s still a check-first kind of size. Surfline and MEO Beachcam should give you a quick read, and this one can get heavy fast, especially with the falling tide. If the wave line looks clean and not too blown out, it should be usable; if not, I’d pass and save the drive.
